tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /gdan sa chen po ra lung gi khyad par 'phags pa cung zad brjod pa ngo mtshar gyi gter zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /
༄༅/ /gdan sa chen po ra lung gi khyad par 'phags pa cung zad brjod pa ngo mtshar gyi gter zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// gdan sa chen po ra lung gi khyad par 'phags pa cung zad brjod pa ngo mtshar gyi gter zhes bya ba bzhugs so// "$ (1ba2)༄༅// shra ya sa stu/ 'jig rten gsum na snyan par grags pa dpal 'brug pa rin po che zhes 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi sprul pa'i sku rabs nas rabs su byon pa dang 'byon par 'gyur ba thams cad kyi zhabs kyi padmo la gtugs te gus pa thams cad kyis zhes byas te phyag 'tshal lo// sems nyid lta ba gnam gyi sha mong des/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i go sar dbang bskur ba/ dus gsum chos kyi rgyal por lung pa/ phan bde'i lung rnams 'gyed mkhan de la 'dud/ grub gnas gang ba'i zla rgyas 'di nang du/ sbyin pa'i spyan ras drang srong la gzigs de'i/ ngang tshul ri mo thugs rje nor lha'i bus/ bris pa thub bstan rgya mtsho'i dpal cis min/ 'di yi dul red de snyed grub pa'i dbang*/ gzhan sman lhur len la chags de yin/ rgyu med bdag la mnyes gshin bzang 'di'i phyogs/ dad pa'i gom pa mi 'dor de blun po/ 'di bskor mi bzad 'khor ba'i 'jigs 'bral bar/ rdo la bris mtshungs dam pas zhal bzhes pas/ shes ldan go ba'i gter 'dzin thams cad du/ 'dir shog legs byas kun gyi dga' ston bya/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten thams cad kyi phyag gi gnas/ mchod pa'i rten/ bsod nams gsog pa'i zhing khams dam par gyur pa ni/ gdan sa chen po dpal lung thel zhes bya ba kun nas grub pa'i gandho la chen po 'di yin te/ thams cad las khyad par du 'phags pa bcu gsum gyis ngo mtshar bar gyur pas so// khyad par du 'phags pa bcu gsum ni/ phyi gnas la brten pa'i khyad 'phags bzhi/ nang rten gsum la brten pa'i khyad 'phags bzhi/ gsang ba bstan pa bstan 'dzin sogs la brten pa'i khyad 'phags bzhi/ de kho na nyid phan bde thams cad kyi 'byung khungs su gyur pas khyad par 'phags pa gcig ste bcu gsum/

dang po bzhi 'ang phyi sa'i dpyad/ der gnas pa'i lha/ ming 'dogs pa'i (2na3)rgyu mtshan/ skyes bu dam pas byin gyis brlabs pas khyad par du 'phags pa bzhi yin la/ de las dang po ni/ gdan sa chen po 'di'i sa gzhi padma 'dab ma brgyad pa kha bye ba lta bu/ gangs dang*/ rdza dang*/ she dang*/ spang gi ri thams cad kyis kun nas bskor te 'dud pa lta bu/ chu phran brgya phrag du ma nang du 'du ba/ gangs dbyibs de lta bu yin pas/ de'i gnam yang 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad par grub bo// logs bkra shis pa'i rtags brgyad kyis nye bar brgyan pa yin te/ sgom sde'i gdong ri dung dkar po g.yas su 'khyil ba lta bu/ ra la'i rtse mo rin po che'i gdugs phub pa lta bu/ spos skya'i rgya ba ri bum pa gang ba lta bu/ btsan chu'i ri rgyal mtshan bsgreng ba lta bu/ yang dgon gyi rgyab ri dang*/ de'i mdun gser nya ma bu 'khyil ba lta bu/ sgo mo'i thang gser gyi 'khor lo bskor ba lta bu/ spen thang phyogs kyi ri padma'i sdong po kha bye ba la/ chu phran rgya bya kha sprod 'gying ba lta bu/ rgya mo na kha thugs dpal be'u lta bu/ de lta bu'i sa'i gnad la brtan nas/ sgrub gnas 'di chags/ de'i rten 'brel las/ kha ba can gyi ljongs 'dir snying po don gyi bstan pa 'dzin pa'i bsgrub grwa bye ba snyed chags pa yin te/ chos rje'i gsung las kyang*/ ngas dgon pa ngam shod du btab na kha drag /skyid shong du btab na 'du long che/ khu le gnam mthil du btab na nor che yang bstan pa la de tsam phan khebs ma mthong*/ 'dir btab na bsgrub rgyud kyi bstan pa nyin mo lta bur 'gyur ba yin gsungs pas/ khyad par 'phags pa ste/ dper na/ chos 'khor lha sa'i sa'i gnad lta bu'o// gnyis pa ni/ sgrub gnas chen po de'i rgyab/ 'o ma thang nas/ stag la'i bar gyi gangs ri'i 'phreng ba la gnod yin nor bu bzang po zhes grags te/ de'i rgyu mtshan/

byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po/ bskal pa bzang po 'di'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi bstan pa bsrung ba la/ gnod sbyin rnams (2ba4)kyi rgyal po gang ba bzang po'i sras su legs par 'khrungs shing*/ de'i mtshan/ gnod sbyin nor bu bzang po zhes bya ba yin la/ de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mthu stobs kyi rdo rje lag tu gtad nas/ gsang ba thams cad kyi bdag por dbang bskur bas/ gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje zhes bya'o// de lta bu'i byang chub sems dpa' chen po des/ bod kha ba can gyi 'dre srin gdug pa can gyi kha gnon du/ 'dir sprul pa'i sku re bzhugs shing*/ de'i dbang gis gnas 'di byin rlabs kyi mthu che zhing bkra shis la g.yang chags pa yin no// de'i yab gang ba bzang pos kyang*/ ha 'o'i gangs 'dun sar mdzad pa gnyis kyis/ 'di bod khams thams cad la longs spyod 'byung ba la/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu rgyal mtshan gyi rtse la bkod pa dang mtshungs pas/ khyad par du 'phags pa yin no// gsum pa ni/ yul 'di la dang po 'brog khu le zhes ming du chags pa las/ phyis sprul pa'i ra ma dkar mo zhig /phyugs rdzis nyin gyi res brlag pa nam zhig rtsad chod pa na/ da lta'i gtsug lag khang chen mo yod pa'i thad 'dir/ rdo zhig la 'o ma 'thor/ de drod kyis bsro kyi 'dug pa mthong nas/ der phyin pas yi ge a hūṃ rang byon 'bur du dod pa rnyed/ de dus grub thob gling phebs pa dang 'grig nas de la phul/ gad ngos la sgrub phug bzos nas/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug chen po der bzhugs/ sprul pa'i rams lung bstan pas/ ra lung zhes/ de nas grags shing*/ rang byon 'di sna phu chos lung gi khyad 'phags gsum gyi gya gcig tu da lta yang bzhugs so// bzhi pa ni/ mtshan de ltar gsol ba'i gnas 'di nyid du grub thob chen po gling*/ chos kyi rgyal po gtsang pa rgya ras nas/ dus deng sang gi bar/ zhing 'di nyid kyi rdul gyi grangs dang mnyam pa'i rnal 'byor pa/

rdo rje theg pa'i sgo nas/ tshe gcig lus gcig gis rigs thams cad kyi khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen por mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i sa yin pas rdo rje'i gdan/ byang chub kyi snying po chos kyi g.ye'i dgon pa chen por gyur la/ da dung (3na5)bstan pa nam gnas kyi bar du/ dpag tu med pa 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur bas/ skyes bu chen po de dag gis byin gyis brlabs pa yin pas/ khyad par du 'phags pa rgya gar rdo rje gdan bzhin no// gnyis pa/ nang rten gsum la brten pa'i khyad 'phags la/ sku rten/ gsung rten/ thugs rten/ rang byon khyad par du 'phags pa'o// dang po ni/ chos rje'i sku sku 'bag khams gsum zil gnon/ dge ba dang mi dge ba'i ltas zhal ras la mngon sum du bzhugs pa lta bur gsal ba/ tshe 'di'i zhen pa can gyi skye bo la yang*/ yud tsam chags pa med pa zhi gnas kyi ting nge 'dzin skye nus pa de dang*/ gzhan yang*/ sangs rgyas dbon la sogs pa'i zhal ngo'i nang rten// smad 'brug gi btan pa'i mda' bdag /rgyal ba lo ras pa'i nang rten/ mgon po tsa ri ras chen gyis bzhengs shing*/ rab tu gnas par mdzad pa dang*/ stod 'brug gi bstan pa'i mnga' bdag /rgyal ba rgod tshang ba'i nang rten/ grub thob u rgyan pas bzhengs shing*/ rab gnas mdzad pa nas brtsams te/ deng sang grub pa dang grub pa'i sa la chas pa mang po'i gdung gi snying po can rnams dang*/ slob dpon chen po klu sgrub kyi thugs dam mgon po'i rdo sku/ dpal rgwa las spyan drangs pa dang*/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po phyag bzhi pa dngul ljang brdungs kyi sku/ rgyan rnams gser ljang brdungs dang g.yu sbyang spel legs kyi phras mdzes pa/ rgyab mtho lnga pa/ padma dkar pos bzhengs pa'i bar gyi gtsug lag khang gong 'og til gyi gang bu lta bur bkang ba rnams so// gnyis pa ni/ rin po che be ḍū rya zhun mas bris pa'i glegs bam/ gan shog mthing shun la gser bzang pos bris pa'i bka' 'gyur/

'bum shog mo che la sogs pa'i skya bod brgya phrag mang po dang*/ khyad par rgyud sde bzhi'i khong pa'i snying lta bu'i man ngag rnams/ u rgyan gyi dharma gañdzo dang mtshungs par rgya rim pa bdun gyis btab ste bzhugs pa yin pas khyad par du 'phags pa yin no// gsum pa ni/ chos rje'i zhal nas kho bo'i shul du/ rten bkra (3ba6)shis sgo mangs su bgyis na/ dka' brgyud kyi bstan pa mtha' rgyas su 'gyur ba yin/ zhes lung bstan pa ltar/ sangs rgyas dbon gyis/ gser 'bum 'dzam bu gling gi rgyan bzhengs pa'i nang na/ chos rje'i thugs dang dbu thod la byon pa'i rigs gsum mgon po dang*/ dkar brgyud gong ma la sogs pa'i byin rlabs kyi rten tshad med pa bzhugs pas/ 'di'i rten 'brel las/ sgrub gnas 'di gdan sa mar gyur pa yin no// phyi rten du mchod rten bkra shis sgo mangs 'di bzhengs pa yin zhing*/ 'di phal cher grub/ gañdza ri nyi ma'i snying po zhag 'ga'i bar du bzo bos skyon mtshugs shing*/ tha ma'i nyin de dag dro la log pa'i shul du/ sangs rgyas dbon stag rir bzhugs dus/ mngon par mkhyen pas gzigs nas/ rkyang mo drus ma zhig la chibs te rdzu 'phrul gyis 'dir byon/ gañdzi ra legs par bskyon/ phyir yang rkyang la chibs nas/ thegs la khad pa khong rnams dro grol bas mthong ste brgyugs pas ma zin/ chibs sa'i pha bong de la/ rkyang gi rmig rjes gsal bar byon/ de rnyed pa dus da lta'i bar du yod do// de nas rab tu gnas pa'i dus su// gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thams cad nam mkha' la lhags nas shis pa brjod pa kun gyis mthong ba byung*/ zhes grags shing*/ sangs rgyas dbon gyi gsung nas/ ma 'ongs pa na 'di la zhig gsos dgos pa'i dus zhig 'ong*/ de dus kho bo rang sleb nas byed pa yin zhes/ kho bo cag gi rje 'byon par/ 'di dus lung bstan pa yin no// gzhan yang mchod rten 'di'i sku che ba'i yon tan/

rgyal ba rgod tshang pas/ nga'i sgom ma sle'u thul can 'di rnams nyin mong la chos zhu/ nub mo ra lung gi nā ro pa'i phyi rten la skor ba bskor nas/ nub phyogs u rgyan gyi yul du tshogs kyi skal ba len pa la rgyun du 'gro ba yin/ zhes gsungs pa ltar du/ grub chen u rgyan pas u rgyan du byon pa na/ yul de'i bu mo rnams kyi ngang tshul rgyal ba rgod tshang pas ji ltar gsungs pa ltar du (4na7)gzigs nas/ mchod rten 'di'i bsngags pa ches cher brjod par mdzad do// gzhan yang rgyal ba yang dgon par lung bskor ba la phebs dus mnal lam du/ mchod rten chen po 'di'i bum nang du rdo rje 'chang nas/ rgyal ba rgod tshang pa la thug gi bar du dkar brgyud kyi bla ma thams cad gral mthar chags su bzhugs pa las/ mi la ras pa'i bzhugs khri stong par 'dug pa la khyod sdod rgyu yin zhes gzigs pa sogs kyis che ba brjod par mdzad cing*/ da lta skor mi nyung dus yang bskor lam mang pos phyin pa ltar byang bar 'gyur ba kun mthun snang grub pa yin no// gzhan yang rjes bzhengs pa'i rgyal dbang rje'i dngul 'bum dang gser 'bum/ rgyal tshab dam pa ngag gi dbang phyug gis bzhengs pa'i sgra bsgyur gyi rgyal po mar pa lo tsa'i rnam 'phrul/ mtshan lan cig thos pas kyang srid pa'i gud pa thams cad zhi bar mdzad pa ngag dbang chos kyi rgyal po'i sku gdung ril po gcig tu bzhugs pa'i gser 'bum bkra shis dpal 'bar thog tshad gsum lhag pa rgyu dang*/ bzo dang*/ rab tu gnas pa la sogs pa phul du phyin pa de la sogs pa'i mchod rten gyis sros skya'i gtsug lag khang chen mo yongs su gang ba rnams so// bzhi pa ni/ chos rje gtsang pa rgya ras kyi sku tshigs pa nyi shu rtsa gcig la spyan ras gzigs nyi shu rtsa gcig byon pa'i gsum rang byon khyad 'phags kyi gral du bzhugs/ gzhan gdan sa 'di nyid kyi phyi rten nang rten gnyis su re re/

chos rje gzhon nu'i nang rten mgon khang gi mchod sdong gser ra bre gang gsol ba 'di nang du gcig /'brug gi lha mo che dang mchod rten gnyis su re re/ mdo mkhar dang chos rdzong gi gdung rten la re re/ byang u ri dang lho brag mkho mthing lha khang du re re yod pa'i phyi ma da lta bya yul gyi gsal rje'i sgrub sde na bzhugs so// sbu tra dang*/ ne'u rings na re re/ dang po ti se'i mchod gzhis dkar du ma na gcig yod pa da lta gu ger byon zhes grags/ gnas rnying dang chos lung tshogs pa la rten brjed mdzad (4ba8)pas re re/ 'bras mo jo btsun la gnyis yod pu'i gcig 'bras mo'i mchod rten na dang*/ gcig lho dgon pa yul gyi yon rdzong pa'i lag na/ dbon grags pa ye shes kyi rten skal du khams rong po gser pas ra gcig brdzangs/ hor rgyal po thog gan the mur gyis/ chos rje bcu gsum pa bla'i mchod gnas su bteg /hor dud stong dgu brgya 'ja sa dang bcas pas gtsug lag khang gong 'og la thig rtsa blangs ba'i/ ding phon gyi bla re padma 'bum ldan dang*/ stong ldan dang khra/ a ka ru nag po dang*/ nya lcibs kyi cog tse la sogs pa'i mchod rdzas dpag tu med pa phul ba'i gdab len du gcig brdzangs pa rnams yin la/ de dag las mchog tu gyur pa/ chos rje nyid dang gnyis su med pa rang byon khar sa paṇa 'di yin la/ 'di yang sangs rgyas dbon gyi sku thog la zhig po nyi ma seng ges bsnams nas/ la stod phyogs la 'bul sdud la byon/ mchod rten chen mo'i gañdzir gdugs zar tshogs dang bcas pa legs par bsgrubs nas phyir log snye nam tshong 'dus su phebs/ de bsgrigs pas khrom chen po tshogs/ de'i dbus su zhig po nyams 'bar pas/ rten thag chad nas zegs pa rgan 'khogs dbul po gnyis kyis rnyed/ de gnyis btsan thabs su longs spyod rnam thos kyi bu lta bur song*/ der khong gnyis kyis mchod pa byas nas lo bco lnga tsam bzhugs/

dus nam zhig khong gza' mi gnyis gros gleng ba/ rten khyad par du 'phags pa 'di'i byin rlabs kyis/ 'o skol skyid par byung*/ da dung yang 'bral mi phod de rten 'di dge ba'i bshes gnyen gcig gi phyag tu bzhugs na/ sems can gyi don rgya chen po 'byung nges pas/ 'u cag gis bdag tu ma bzung ba drag /de su la 'dul zhes gleng*/ de dus rgyal ba rgod tshang pa grags che bas de'i phyag tu gdan 'dren pa la kha 'cham mo// de'i dus su chos kyi rgyal po rgyal ba rgod tshang pa'i zhal nas/ 'o skol gyi 'di ru do zhag chos rje 'byon pa 'dug gsung pa dang*/ yang dus nam zhig na nye gnas la de ring chos rje byon pa yod pas/ mar yod pa (5na9)rnams bzhus/ dkar me'i chas gyis/ sha dad thud dang rtsam pa rnams dge 'dun rnams la dga' ston la 'dren pa yin no// de ring nga yang mtshams bsangs te bsu ba la 'gro ba yin gsungs nas/ gzims spyil gyi phyi ru gyon pa dang*/ sgrub pa po thams cad spyan sngar 'phungs nas yun ring rab 'gor ba dang chos rje'i zhal nas/ 'di ltar ma byed la 'ur 'gro/ chos rje rtsa 'di rang na 'byon gyi yod gsungs nas byon pa dang mi gnyis byung ba dang phrad pas/ rgyal ba rgod tshang pas phyag mdzad pa dang*/ thams cad kyis phyag byas pas/ khong gnyis ci yin nam snyam ha las 'dug skad/ chos rje'i zhal nas/ khyod kyi mchan khung gi be bum de nga'i lag tu thong zhig /gsungs pa dang*/ khong yang*/ rten dang chos rje gnyis ka la mos par gyur to/ chos rje'i phyag tu phul ba dang*/ da bu thog tu bzhag nas 'gro mgon chos rje dang dngos su mjal gsungs nas spyan chab mang po 'byon cing yun ring gsol ba 'debs kyin de kar bzhugs so// yab sras gnyis po mjal bas thugs tshim zhing bsam pa'i don thams cad grub par mdzad do// der chos rje'i nang du gdan drangs te mchod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas mnyes par mdzad do// chos rje rgod tshang pas yon bdag de la bya dga' la rta dang nor mang po gnang*/

khong gnyis kyis kyang rta dang nor tsho chos rje nyid la phul nas chos kyi 'brel pa mang du zhus te/ don thams cad grub pa yin no zer nas yul du song skad do// nyi ma la stod kyi phyogs su 'gro don rgya chen po byung zhing*/ lo bcu bdun gyi bar du bzhugs so// de nas chos rje rgod tshang bas/ gdan sa la 'bul chen gsum mdzad pa'i phyi ma la gdan sar phul zhing*/ gar bzhugs la gzhi bdag rnams sho rgyab song bas/ gang bzang dang mi sngon rta sngon gnyis rgyal bas ra lung du gzhog ces gsungs/ de nas chos rje spos skya pa'i bar du mjal kha shin tu dog pa la/ chos rje des bskor mi brgya phrag longs pa la mjal ba'i srol btsugs (5ba10)pa yin no// rang byon 'di rang mor 'brug /lha pas bcom pa'i dus/ car gyis gzims pa dang*/ 'bri gung gling log gi dus su/ sku sngo bsangs su gyur pa byung zhes grag cing*/ phyis rje'i dus su'ang khrom gyi dbus su yal bzhag bdun gsol ba btab pas slar phebs pa dang*/ mi dge na sku yo ba dang*/ nogs pa dang*/ dge na shel dri ma med pa lta bur yong ba/ da lta kun gyi mthun snang du grub bo// da lta'i bzhugs khang dza mu tig la sogs rin po che sna bdun las grub pa 'di/ dge slong padma dkar po bdag gis rgyu sbyar/ dpal reg pa med pa'i mchod rten gyi dbyibs su bkod pa'i khyad par thams cad kyis 'phags par byas pa/ bal po phrag po'i lus lon pa la mkhas pa/ dpon mo che dza shing gis lo gcig gi ring la 'bad pas bya yul du bsgrubs shing*/ bya yul chos kyi rgyal po'i btsun mo tshogs gnyis grub ma dang*/ don gnyis grub ma mched kyi sku rgyan gyi g.yu sbyang yang mang du phul/ 'di'i rgyu la rin thang brtsis na gser zho stong phrag gsum du longs pa tsam song ngo*// chos rje'i sku tshigs la byon pa'i 'phags pa bcu gcig zhal bzhugs khang bkra shis sgo mangs/

yang sku tshigs la byon pa'i 'phags pa zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa bzhugs khang cho 'phrul mchod rten/ rin po che spos skya pa'i sku gdung la byon pa'i khar sa paṇa bzhugs khang lha babs mchod rten/ rje kun dga' seng ge'i zhun thigs la byon pa'i thub pa'i dbang po'i sku ngo mtshar ba bzhugs khang byang chub mchod rten/ yang kun dga' seng ge'i zhun thigs las byon pa'i spyan ras gzigs don yong zhags pa bzhugs khang dbyen bsdum mchod rten/ 'jam dbyangs blo gros seng ge'i sku gdung la byon pa spyan ras gzigs zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa bzhugs khang rnam rgyal mchod rten/ paṇa chen shākya shrī'i sku gdung zhun thigs las byon pa'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ bzhugs khang rnam rgyal mchod rten/ 'di tshogs chos lung pa (6na11)dang rten brjes pa der 'dug ste som nyi/ bla ma g.yu mo che da'i dbu thod la byon par dgyes pa rdo rje zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa/ bzhugs khang myang 'das mchod rten/ 'di gnas rnying pa dang rten pa rjes pa der 'dug ste so ma nyi/ sangs rgyas kyi 'phel gdung bzhugs khang gnyis med ye shes mchod rten/ 'di rgyal mkhar rtse'i 'phel gdung las mched pa/ rje mar pa'i tshems gdung log 'phel gdung gis brgyan pa/ gdan sa gro bo lung nas byung ba/ bzhugs khang lha babs mchod rten/ yang rje mar pa'i tshems 'phel gdung bzhugs khang dbyen sdum mchod rten/ yang rje mar pa'i sku gdung las byon pa'i 'phel gdung*/ 'di gzhis ka sne ba'i phyag na/ gdung sha rī ri sran ma sbom shos tsam zhig yod pa phyis sne'u 'thor zhig la song skabs dkon gnyer pas khyer nas stod lungs sgang du sleb/ de nas 'brug pa rin po ches der phebs dus gzigs phul bas phyag mthil rang du de las ring bsrel bdun cu 'dzegs pa ma god bar 'dir bzhugs pa yin la/ de nas dbu gzung ma bu thams cad las ring bsrel tshad med 'phel bas/

da lta mar pa'i ring bsrel gar bzhugs yang 'di las mched par snang*/ bzhugs khang cho 'phrul mchod rten/ chos rje'i 'phel gdung brgyad bzhugs khang bkra shis sgo mangs/ 'di rje 'brug pa rin po che ngag dbang chos kyi rgyal pos khyad 'phags bzhugs khang bzo dus/ khar sa paṇa phyag tu bzhes sku khrus gsol bas phyag tu ring bsrel dgu babs pa'i gcig phyi la shor/ lhag ma 'dir bzhugs/ yang chos rje'i tshems 'phel gdung bzhugs khang cho 'phrul mchod rten/ yang chos rje'i tshems 'phel gdung bzhugs khang dbye na sdum mchod rten/ yang chos rje'i gdung sha rī ra bzhugs khang dbyen bsdum mchod rten/ yang chos rje'i dbu thod la byon pa'i ring bsrel gsum bsgrigs bzhugs khang rnam rgyal mchod rten/ sangs rgyas dbon gyi tshems 'phel gdung (6ba12)bzhugs khang pad spungs mchod rten/ rje nyi ma'i tshems 'phel gdung bzhugs khang rnam rgyal mchod rten/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' seng ge'i tshems la byon pa'i dud dkar g.yas 'khyil bzhugs khang rnam rgyal mchod rten/ rgyal ba'i dbang po'i sku sogs g.yas pa la byon pa'i 'phags pa khar sa paṇa bzhugs khang byang chub mchod rten/ yang rgyal ba'i dbang po'i tshems 'phel gdung bzhugs khang pad spungs mchod rten/ yang rgyal ba'i dbang po'i tshems 'phel gdung bzhugs khang dbyen bsdum mchod rten/ yang rgyal ba'i dbang po'i tshems 'phel gdung bzhugs khang byang chub mchod rten/ ngag dbang chos kyi rgyal po'i tshems dung dkar g.yas 'khyil gsum tshoms su byon pa bzhugs khang rnam rgyal mchod rten/ 'jam dbyangs chos kyi grags pa'i tshems la dung dkar g.yas 'khyil gcig byon pa bzhugs khang dbyen bsdum mchod rten/ yang 'jam dbyangs chos kyi grags pa'i tshems 'phel gdung bzhugs khang rnam rgyal mchod rten/ phal cher rje 'brug pa rin po che ngag dbang chos kyi rgyal pos bzhengs par 'dug

/drug tsam da ltar 'tsho zhing gzhes pa'i rgyal sras dbon gyis bzhengs pa/ de dag kyang bum pa gser ljang brdungs la g.yu dang mu tig gi phra tshoms bang rim dang bre dngul dkar/ seng khri gser zangs gdugs spos shel las bsrubs pa/ phyi ljang gser gyi dra mig gis bskor ba/ che chung rje 'brug pa rin po che'i phyag mtho re na yin te khru tshad kyi rkang gar ba re 'dug go// zhar la 'gro ba'i mgon po'i spur khang gi rdo la 'khrungs pa'i a gnyis hrīḥgacig bzhugs khang ze'u lha khang*/ sangs rgyas dbon gyi phyag rjes rdo nag la byon pa bzhugs khang ze'u lha khang*/ rnal 'byor chos 'byung gi dbu thod la a hūṃ gsal bar byon pa bzhugs khang rgya phebs tog dang bcas pa ljang ser/ rgya gar rdo rje gdan gyi bkod pa byang chub ljon shing las grub pa bzhugs khang ljang ser rgya phubs tog dang bcas pa/ 'gro ba'i mgon po zhal bzhugs pa'i thugs (7na13)dam bde mchog zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa yum dang bcas pa/ bzhugs khang ze'u lha khang*/ pan chen shākya shrī'i thugs dam rdo rje rnal 'byor ma bzhugs khang ze'u lha khang*/ nā ro pa'i phyag 'khar chu shing nag po sogs so// gsum pa bstan pa bstan 'dzin sogs khyad par 'phags pa bzhi yang*/ gang du gang dar ba'i bstan pa/ de gang las 'ongs pa'i brgyud pa/ de 'dzin pa'i skyes bu/ tshul ji ltar gzung ba khyad par du 'phags pa'o// dang po ni/ lta ba thams cad kyi yang rtse/ theg pa thams cad kyi mthar thug /grub mtha' thams cad kyi zhe phugs/ rdo rje theg pa las kyang*/ snying po gsang sngags bla na med pa 'ba' zhig gi sgra 'dir grag ste/ de yang*/ shin tu rmad du byung ba'i rgyud/ bsre 'pho gnad kyi mtshams sbyor/ zhes bya ba jo bo nā ro pa'i khyad par gyi chos su grags pa/ rje btsun mar pas/ bsre ba dang 'pho ba ma gtogs pa'i/ khyad chos brgya dang rtsa brgyad shes/ zhes gsungs pas/

'chad tshul las bla med kyi rgyud sde brgya phrag gcig gi lam rim brgya phrag gcig khongs su gnas pa dang*/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i man ngag snyan rgyud nor bu skor gsum/ zhes grags pa'i khyad par can de dang*/ kye'i rdo rje'i rdzogs rim 'byung ba ro snyoms zhes grags pa dang*/ pha rgyud gsang ba 'dus pa'i man ngag rim lnga'i khrid/ mahā mā ya'i rnal 'byor gsum/ gdan bzhi la sogs pa mar lugs kyi smar khrid brgya rtsa dang*/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i man ngag /rdo rje gsum pa/ rdo rje bzhi'i bsnyen sgrub sbyor ba yan lag drug rgyas bsdus kyis bzhag pa de dang*/ gsang ba 'dus pa dang*/ sambu ṭa las phyung ba lam zab bla ma sgrub pa/ mdo rgyud gcig tu bsre ba rten 'brel gyi skor/ grub pa sde bdun/ snying po skor drug la sogs pa'i man ngag gi snying po phyag rgya chen po chos rje nyid kyi gsung zin bris las 'phros nas/ stong 'brug la grags pa'i khrid chen brgyad/ smad 'brug la grags pa thub pa lnga/ bar 'brug la (7ba14)grags pa dge sbyor bdun pa/ gzhan yang*/ bde dgyes la sogs pa rgyud 'grel dbang dang bcas pa/ gsang ba bstan pa dang*/ dngos grub 'byung ba'i rgyud la sogs pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas sgrub thabs las tshogs dang bcas pa'i gdams ngag thams cad kyis gang zag cig car ba dang*/ thod brgal ba dang*/ rim gyis pa rang rang gi lam gyis rdo rje 'chang gis la bkri bar mdzad pa yin te/ de lta yang rgyal dbang chos rjes/ chos zab dgu 'dus pa'i pho brang la/ 'brug dang ra lung mi zer ram/ zhes gsungs shing*/ skyes bu gsum gyi lam dwags po'i chos bzhi zhes grags pa dag kyang ngo*// gnyis pa ni/ de lta bu'i tshes lugs de dag kyang*/ rdo rje 'chang nas rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar du brgyud pa ma chad cing*/ gzhan la ma bltos pas na pha rjes bus zin pa sha stag ste/ rgyal dbang chos rjes/ sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa bcos ma ma yin pa zab gsal lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes mngon sum du ngo sprod par byed pa rtogs pa don gyi dbang mchog sems la bskur bas/

snang srid sku gsum gyi rgyal srid la dbang bsgyur ba'i brgyud pa zam ma chad pas dbang gi chu bo gzhung ma nyams tshul 'di lta bu la brten nas phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob pas/ thun mong gi dngos grub zhar la brnyes pa'i brgyud pa zam ma chad pas dngos grub kyi rgya mtsho kha ma bri/ sems nyid yid bzhin gyi nor bu la byi dor byas pas/ dgos 'dod mtha' dag sems la grub pa'i brgyud pa mnyams pas/ rtogs pa'i nor bu 'od ma yal/ snyan rgyud zab ma tshong 'dus kyi 'o ma bzhin gzhan gyi bsre ba slad kyi dbang du ma song zhing*/ man ngag zab mo nyams su bstar bas gdams pa'i bdud rtsi bcud ma nyams pa ste/ de ltar rnam pa bzhi'i sgo nas gzhan las khyad par gyur pa yin zhes gsungs/ de lta bu'i (8na15)brgyud pa 'di yang*/ rgya gar gyi yul dbus su/ bram ze sa ra ha nas brtsams/ lo dril nag po spyod pa la sogs pa dang*/ nub phyogs u rgyan gyi yul du phyag rdor gyi sprul pa drang srong 'gro ba dbugs 'byin/ rgyal po'i bu mo rol pa mo nas/ slob dpon la ba pa'i bar dang*/ rgya gar lho phyogs su klu sgrub snying po dang*/ sha ba ri dbang phyug /shar phyogs su slob dpon chen po tilli pa/ byang phyogs su mkhas pa chen po nā ro pa ste/ rgya gar gyi grub thob brgyad cu rtsa bzhi/ phal che ba brgyud pa 'di'i bla ma gong mar snang ba dang*/ bod du yang*/ sgra bsgyur mar pas/ rje btsun la/ bu slob ma bas kyang yang slob bzang*/ nyid slob nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam/ zhes lung bstan pa'i bu ni rje zla 'od gzhon nu dang*/ rje btsun ras chung la sogs pa/ slob ma ni rje sgom pa dang*/ phag mo gru pa/ dbu se/ lo sum la sogs pa/ yang slob ni/ grub chen gling*/ 'bri stag /tshal ba/ g.ya' bzang pa/ khro phu la sogs par gyes pa rnams so// nying slob ni chos kyi rgyal po gtsang pa rgya ras pa ste/

'di las stod 'brug gnam gyi skar ma lta bu/ smad 'brug sa'i dreg pa lta bu/ bar 'brug dbu che nyis stong brgyad brgya las brgyud pa sangs rgyas dbon nas gdan sa brgyud de bzhir gyes shing*/ 'di'i bstan pas bya rgod kyi nyin lam bco brgyad khyab par grags la/ de dag rab tu byung ba dang*/ rnal 'byor pa la sogs pa cha lugs nges med kyis snying po'i bstan pa 'dzin par mdzad pa yin no// de yang sher phyin gyi mdor/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di yul dbus su dar bar 'gyur ro// de nas lho/ de nas byang*/ byang nas byang gi phyogs su dar bar 'gyur ro// 'on kyang dam pa'i chos 'dul ba snying por byed pa ni ma yin no// zhes gsungs pa yang*/ ston pas brgyud pa rin po che 'di kho na lung bstan pa yin no// gsum pa ni/ de yang (8ba16)brgyud pa de dang ldan pa'i bla ma de'i 'jig rten dang bstun te rigs kyi che ba bshad par bya ste/ chos kyi rgyal po srong btsan bzhugs pa'i dus rgya nag gi yul nas/ jo bo rin po che spyan 'dren pa'i rgya'i gyad pa mched gnyis 'ongs pas/ gyad lha dga' dang klu dga' zhes grags so// lha dga'i dbon sras las khri srong lde'u btsan gyi dus su rgya sang shi dang gsal gnang zhes chos bsgyur ba'i ched du dka' las mdzad pas/ rgyal po'i thugs la gces pas ming sba zhes btags so// sba gsal snang rab tu byung nas bsam yas su mkhan po'i dngos kyi gdan sa mdzad/ bod rgyal po'i bla mar gyur/ sang shi'i tsha bo khri ral gyi dus su/ rgya 'jam dpal gsang ba zhes grags pa slob dpon chen po padma la sogs pa la gtugs nas/ rig sngags 'chang thams cad gyi rtse mor 'thon pa byung*/ des nyang stod du dpal skyegs gyi gnas btab pas/ da lta gnas rnying du grags pa 'di yin/ de nas dus kyi dbang gis dbon sras stag tshal du 'phos/ de nas bstan pa phyi dar gyi dus su/

rgya brtson 'grus seng ge zhes bya ba mkhas pa jo bo rje bod du gdan 'dren pa po de byung ba yin no// de'i dbon sras khu ler 'phos pa'i brgyud du chos rje 'di 'khrungs pa yin no// de yang gu ru chos dbang gi gter ma/ slob dpon padma dang kha ri'i zhu lan du/ sa ral zhes pa'i lung gsum mdor/ nor bu 'dzin pa'i sprul pa zhig /pha bong sho 'dra'i kha nas chos 'chad rtsom/ zhes spyan ras gzigs yin par dang*/ ratna gring pa dang padma gling pa'i gter yig tu/ slob dpon gyis/ nā ro paṇa chen sgyu ma'i gar bsgyur ba/ gtsang pa rgya ras 'brug dang ra lung byon/ zhes gsungs shing chos rje rten ras pa las/ phyis bstan pa la phan par dgongs nas bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i dus su/ bla ma zhang g.yu brag pas/ nā ro paṇa chen gyi (9na17)skra gcod mkhan nga min pa su yod ces/ rgod ma dkar mo zhon nas brgyugs pa dang*/ grub chen gling gis thel gyi gnas bstod du/ dpral ba'i dkyil na mdongs gcig yod// mdongs de gling chen ras pa yin// mdongs kyi dkyil nas 'khyug cing byung*// 'khyug de nā ro paṇa chen yin// zhes nā ro pa ra lung bstan pa dang*/ chos rje nyid kyis kyang de ltar zhal gyis bzhes pa yin no// de lta bu'i dbon brgyud la gdan rabs brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i bar du 'byung zhing*/ de dag gi bstan pa nyag phra ba'i skabs su/ sngar rgyal dbang rje byon pa lta bu/ chos rje rang gi sprul pa dgu 'byung ba yin te/ chos kyi rje'i zhal chems su// 'dir yang gdung gsob brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i dgus/ bla ma'i gdung 'dzin bstan pa rgyas byed 'gyur/ zhes gsungs pas so// de ltar brgyad cu rtsa bzhi po thams cad kyang*/ spyan ras gzigs kyi sbrul pa brgyad chu dngos su gsungs shing*/ bzhi zhar gyis bstan no// de ltar skyes bu dam pa 'ba' zhig ston pa por gyur ba'i nyan pa po'i slob ma dag kyang zab mo'i chos la mi skrag cing*/

skal ba dang ldan pa la rnam pa tha dad kyang*/ rang bzhin gcig pa rdo rje slob dpon dad rgyud gcig pa lta bus 'khor phun sum tshogs pa yin no// de'i nang nas rdo rje slob dpon gyi bka'i gnang ba thob cing gsung gi mdzod 'dzin pa la/ shwa rags gong du dngos sam sbas pa'i grub thob re dang*/ phyogs su 'gran zla med pa'i bstan pa'i gsal byed re 'byung*/ zhes gtam du grags so// bzhi pa ni/ de lta bur nyan bshad mdzad pa'i skyes bu dam pa de dag gis dang por/ bla ma (9ba18)dam pa las legs par thos/ de nyan pa'i mod nyid du sems pa dang*/ bsgom pas nyams su bstar/ ma bde ba rnams 'phral 'phral la zhus shing*/ dpyad nas sgom pa phul du phyin pa na dman pa'i sa gzung*/ gyong lto gos gtam gsum la bskur/ ri'i bu byas/ na bun gyi gos gyon/ rdo rje theg pa'i spyod pas nyon mongs pa rang bzhin shes pa'i lam gyis sbyangs nas/ spang blang gi mtshan ma rang grol ba tsan dan dad ste'u 'am/ nam mkha' dang lag mthil ltar mnyam pa nyid khong du chud pas/ grub thob chen por 'gyur pas/ mi thams cad kyis mi phyed 'brug pa/ 'brug phyed sprang po/ sprang phyed grub thob ces gtam du grags pa yin no// gzhan ma rnams bla ma la chos nyan pa'i dus su sgom mi mdzad/ phyis bsgom rgyu ba chos mang po zhig nyan pa'i rjes sna dred du gtong ba/ gos ngan pa gyon pa ni ngo tsha/ dma' sa 'dzin dgos byung na dma' ba bsnyam/ mtho sa snyeg /ri khrod 'grim pa dang lto dga' thub ni gsang sngags bde ba lam byed yin pas byed mi dgos chos kha la skya le/ rgyud nyon mongs par khres se/ de'i dbang gis/ rang phyogs bong bu 'dra ba cig kyang kun shes shes 'dra bar bstod/ gzhan phyogs kyi mkhas pa dang grub pa ci mthong yang skyon 'ba'i zhag brjod pas na/ rje btsun chen po mi la ras pa mi khyu nas 'bud dgos byung*/ bdag cag kyang de'i lugs 'dzin yin pas mi khyud tshud pa dka' 'o// gdams ngag kyang ming mi dgos/

rang rgyud la yon tan mthar chags su bskyed nus pa cig gis chog pa yin te/ jo bo rjes/ tshe thung shes bya'i mtha' la zad pa med/ tshe yi tshad kyang ji tsam mi shes pas/ dad pas chu la 'o ma len pa bzhin/ rang gi 'dod pa dang du zad bar gyis/ zhes dang*/ rje btsun mi la ras pas/ shākya thub bstan pa'i snyigs ma la/ mi rnams ne thung longs spyod dbul/ bdud rigs bar chad mang ba'i phyir/ dus yun ring sdod pa'i long med pas/ shes bya'i mtha' la chod dus med/ rgyud sde'i mkhyen rgya mi (10na19)'tshal bas// bu sgrub pa snying por long zhig gsungs// mi ngas kyang le lo ma bgyis par// rje gsung ba'i bka' drin rjes su nyan// gnas ri khrod bas mtha' bsnyegs nas kyang*// zhes gsungs/ de bas na/ thos pa med pa'i sgom chen de/ lag rdum brag la 'dzeg pa 'dra/ zer gyi 'dug kyang*/ brnyas dogs ldang mi dgos par gda'/ skabs 'ga' rer// sangs rgyas gsang bas/ thos pa mang po yang bdud kyi las so// zhes gsungs gda'o// bzhi pa de kho na nyid phan bde thams cad kyi 'byung khungs su gyur pas khyad par du 'phags pa ni ngo mtshar ba'i dpal de dag gis khyad par du gyur pa'i zhing 'di ka 'og min gyi gnas mchog phun sum tshogs pa lnga dang ldan par nges nas/ rab de nyid du tshe gcig lus gcig gis sangs rgyas bsgrub pa'am/ 'bring der re zhig 'dug nas dam pa'i chos kyi bgo skal longs pa dang*/ mtha' ma yang rgyu ci 'byor pas mchod pa dang*/ phyag dang bskor ba la shes ldan rnams kyis 'bad par rigs te/ rang nyid bag med par gyur kyang der phyin na/ skyes bu dam pa de dag dang 'brel bas thugs rje'i lcags kyus thebs pa yin la/ des ngan 'gro log par ltung du mi 'jug par mngon par mtho bar drangs te/ rim gyis byang chub kyi spyod pa bslabs nas/ mtha' na'ang skyes bu de dag gis sprul pa'i zhing grub pa na der bdag gi don chen po 'grub nges shing*/

gzhan du brtson na bdag nyid sngar 'tshang rgya bar yang 'gyur ro// gnas skabs su lus la nang mi 'jug cing zhugs pa zhi ba dang*/ gdon gyis glags mi rnyed la/ snga nas gdon yod na des sel ba dang*/ tshe dang*/ dpal dang*/ mnga' dang*/ 'byor pa/ bu la sogs pa 'jig rten 'di la dgos pa thams cad rang gis smon lam rtse gcig tu btab pa ltar 'grub pa la som nyi mi dgos te/ 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug gzhan gyi don mdzad pa la skad cig kyang g.yel ba mi sred pas so// gzhan 'dul ched du thugs rje'i sgyu ma mkhan/ (10ba20)'bad pas lag rtser chags pa sgyu ma'i zhing*/ grub pa'i byin gyis srid g.yo 'am sgyu lta bu/ brtags pas bzang po'i zong kho sgyu rgod song*/ 'dir dad phyir mi ldog pa'i gtan tshigs te/ stes zla zhor gyis 'di ni 'khor ba yang*/ rtogs dka' 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho 'di'i pha mtha'/ 'di tsam zhes pa kun brtags min par bcad/ des na 'di la mthod thos reg dran pa'i/ 'brel pas sbrel rnams dam pa'i skyo thang gis/ sngon las kyis 'phangs de de nas drangs nas/ mtho ris su bcug thar par 'dren gyur cig /de ltar gdan sa chen po ra lung gi ngo mtshar ba cung zad bsnyad pa 'di yang*/ dpon rin po che mi pham chos kyi rgyal po'i bkas bskul ba ltar/ bod yul shar phyogs su byung ba'i gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇḍi ta padma dkar pos chos kyi rgyal po'i 'dun sa rgyal mkhar rtser sbyar ba dge legs su gyur cig// /sarba maṅga laṃ// chos sbyin rgya cher spel ba'i ched/ par bzhengs glegs bu re re la/ dngul krang yon 'gyer mdzad po ni/ chos rgyal bsod nams rgyal mtshan no/// /
